messages:
jamal: FYI — Received DSAR from EU customer claiming 'right to be forgotten'. They want deletion of all PII and embeddings + confirmation. Legal gave 30 days. Any blockers for immediate action?

marta: Do we have any legal hold or open investigations tied to this customer? Also do we have snapshots / cold archives with that tenant id?

patrick: Spinning up a deletion job needs role `dsar-deleter` — only service account `dsar-runner` currently has it. We also need to ensure KMS unwrap rights to decrypt/delete embeddings blobs in eu-west-1.

ian: If we trigger the job it will touch live KV store + elastic snapshots. Snapshot deletion is async and sometimes delayed by snapshot lifecycle hooks — need to confirm retention/immutability windows with cloud backup team.

marta: @eve — can you confirm legal hold/forensics? If none, we'll proceed. Also we need to record an auditable proof-of-deletion object (sha256 of deleted manifest) and store it in the audit-bucket with restricted access.

eve: No legal hold on this account. Approve deletion. Please preserve chain-of-custody logs and include attestation file; I'll sign the attestation once the artifact is uploaded.

patrick: Question on KMS: if the blobs were encrypted with an older key version that was rotated out, we might not be able to produce a decrypt proof for older snapshots unless key versions are still enabled. Which key wrapped those blobs?

jamal: I checked metadata — embeddings for this tenant were encrypted with key `redwood-eu-embeds-v1` last rotated 2025-11-12. Admins: @marta can you check keystore access logs and whether there are replicas/retained key versions?

marta: Will pull key usage now: `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=redwood-eu-embeds-v1 --location=europe-west1` and check IAM bindings. I'll also run a dry-run deletion and produce a signed proof file (no writes) to validate workflow.

ian: Ops note: schedule deletion in low-traffic window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary plan: delete 10 objects -> verify inference cache invalidation -> verify no downstream routing issues. Also reindexing for data minimization should be throttled.

sec-bot: Incident created: DSAR-2026-042 — https://redwood.incidents/DSAR-2026-042 (automated).

marta: Draft proof-of-deletion format (will redact customer_id in uploaded artifact):
```
{ "customer_id": "<redacted>", "deleted_objects": ["s3://eu-embeds/abc123"], "deleted_at": "2026-03-21T02:15:00Z", "sha256": "<hex>", "operator": "marta" }
```
We will store in `gs://redwood-audit/gdpr-evidence/DSAR-2026-042/` with object-level ACLs and object-level access logs enabled.

patrick: RBAC change proposal: grant temporary binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `serviceAccount:dsar-runner@redwood-infer.iam.gserviceaccount.com` scoped to key `redwood-eu-embeds-v1` for 4 hours. We'll log the grant request and expiry. Is that okay?

eve: Legal OK with temporary bindings provided there's documented approval and expiry. Include ticket id and capture who approved. I'll add my sign-off once PR is open.

marta: I'll open the IAM change PR with `iat` and `exp` in the request metadata and attach the dry-run proof. Also adding an audit hook: every delete op will write a signed entry to the audit-log stream with the proof hash.

jamal: Can we also scrub telemetry / indexed metadata? The DSAR requests removing indexed fields from search and embeddings. That may require reindexing and coordinate with product to avoid breaking features.

ian: Reindex per-tenant will take ~30 minutes and is non-blocking but will spike CPU on the search cluster. We'll throttle concurrency to 2 and run during the same low-traffic window.

patrick: Risk: backups and cold archives older than the retention window may live in provider-managed vaults with minimum retention (eg 90-day legal hold at provider). We need to enumerate backup locations and confirm we can either delete or flag for exception.

marta: Action items: 
- @ian: schedule low-traffic window and run canary + reindex throttle
- @patrick: open temp IAM grant PR + include expiry and link to DSAR ticket
- @marta: run key-access audit, run dry-run delete, upload proof to `gs://redwood-audit/...`
- @eve: sign attestation after proof uploaded
- @jamal: coordinate external comms to customer (copy legal)
I'll start with key logs and dry-run and post updates here.

jamal: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and copy legal when proof is uploaded. Thanks everyone.
